title: Canceled-order refund routing
automatic_trigger: A transition to the closed state schedules the ticket amount and destination for automatic refund processing.
manual_reconciliation_state: A manual bank transfer does not cancel RF-AUTO-17. The ticket remains pending reminder until Billing Reconciliation records removal of the automation link; closed remains the automatic-refund trigger.
verification: After payment, re-read both bank transfer history and the complete ticket state and articles.
